#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Flags a code span with a space just inside a backtick (markdownlint MD038).
set -o pipefail
status=0
while IFS= read -r file; do
  if grep -nE '`( [^`]*|[^`]* )`' "$file" | sed "s|^|$file:|; s|$| MD038 Spaces inside code span elements|"; then
    status=1
  fi
done < <(git ls-files '*.md')
exit "$status"
